nodes.summary: The additive coding `a_A = (X₁ - p) + (X₂ - p)` (centred allele count) at locus `A`.
nodes.title: Additive coding at the first locus

nodes.summary: The additive coding `a_B = (Y₁ - q) + (Y₂ - q)` at locus `B`.
nodes.title: Additive coding at the second locus

nodes.summary: The correlation of the additive codings is the gametic correlation `r = D / √(V_A V_B)`.
nodes.title: Correlation of additive codings equals the gametic correlation

nodes.summary: The dominance coding `d_A = (X₁ - p) (X₂ - p)` at locus `A`.
nodes.title: Dominance coding at the first locus

nodes.summary: The dominance coding `d_B = (Y₁ - q) (Y₂ - q)` at locus `B`.
nodes.title: Dominance coding at the second locus

nodes.summary: For `0`/`1` allele indicators the dominance coding `(X₁ - p) (X₂ - p)` depends only on the genotype `X₁ + X₂` and equals its dominance encoding.
nodes.title: Dominance coding of allele indicators equals the dominance encoding

nodes.summary: Dominance LD is the square of additive LD (Palmer et al. 2023, graphical abstract): the correlation of the dominance codings at two loci is the square of the correlation of their additive codings.
nodes.title: Dominance LD is the square of additive LD

nodes.summary: The dominance encoding of a biallelic genotype `g ∈ {0, 1, 2}` (count of the allele with frequency `p`): `p²`, `-p (1 - p)`, `(1 - p)²`. Dividing by `-p (1 - p)` gives the encoding `-p / (1 - p)`, `1`, `-(1 - p) / p` of Palmer et al. (2023).
nodes.title: Dominance encoding of a biallelic genotype

nodes.summary: The allele frequency (mean coding) `p = E X₁` at locus `A`.
nodes.title: Allele frequency at the first locus

nodes.summary: The allele frequency (mean coding) `q = E Y₁` at locus `B`.
nodes.title: Allele frequency at the second locus

nodes.summary: Additive LD: `E(a_A a_B) = 2 D`.
nodes.title: Additive linkage disequilibrium is twice the gametic one

nodes.summary: The additive coding at `A` and the dominance coding at `B` are uncorrelated: `E(a_A d_B) = 0`.
nodes.title: Additive and dominance codings at different loci are uncorrelated

nodes.summary: The additive coding has second moment `E(a_A²) = 2 V_A`.
nodes.title: Second moment of the additive coding at the first locus

nodes.summary: The additive coding has second moment `E(a_B²) = 2 V_B`.
nodes.title: Second moment of the additive coding at the second locus

nodes.summary: Dominance LD: `E(d_A d_B) = D²`.
nodes.title: Dominance linkage disequilibrium is the square of the gametic one

nodes.summary: The dominance coding has second moment `E(d_A²) = V_A²`.
nodes.title: Second moment of the dominance coding at the first locus

nodes.summary: The dominance coding has second moment `E(d_B²) = V_B²`.
nodes.title: Second moment of the dominance coding at the second locus

nodes.summary: The gametic linkage disequilibrium `D = E (X₁ - p) (Y₁ - q)`.
nodes.title: Gametic linkage disequilibrium

nodes.summary: A diploid two-locus genotype under random union of gametes: the haplotypes `(X₁, Y₁)` and `(X₂, Y₂)` are independent and identically distributed, with square-integrable allele codings.
nodes.title: Two-locus diploid genotype under random union of gametes

nodes.summary: The haplotype variance `V_A = E (X₁ - p)²` at locus `A`.
nodes.title: Haplotype variance at the first locus

nodes.summary: The haplotype variance `V_B = E (Y₁ - q)²` at locus `B`.
nodes.title: Haplotype variance at the second locus

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
